title: Quiet My Heart
hook: Your mind has been racing all day. Let's slow down together for a moment.

bible_verse.text: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

verification.note: Verse quoted from memory (KJV, public domain in the US). Check it against a reliable KJV edition before setting status to 'verified'.

prayer: Lord, my thoughts are crowded and my heart is restless. I bring you the worries I keep replaying and the conversations I cannot stop rehearsing.
Quiet what is loud inside me. Where there is anxiety, plant your peace. Where there is hurry, teach me to rest in you.
I cannot control everything, and I was never meant to. So I place this day, and all its unfinished pieces, in your hands. Amen.
closing: Stay here a moment longer. Breathe in slowly, and let his peace settle over you.
tiktok_description: A short prayer for a restless mind. Put your worries down for a moment. 🕊️
